thread:
Jamal R: Heads up — Acme Analytics just signed an LOI but asked for a one-off pricing exception: 9-month term, 25% on committed usage, and a data residency addendum. Quote here: https://redwood.app/quote/ACME-9832
Alex P: 25% is pretty steep. What’s the ARR and strategic rationale?
Jamal R: Forecasted committed spend is $240k ARR pro-rated to 9 months. They want the residency clause for EU customers only; implied upsell to dedicated next year. Exec sponsor is the VP of Product.
Maria G: From deal desk — we need: net-new logo, sales credit, margin impact calc, and Legal signoff for the residency SLA. Can Sales confirm?
Sarah (RevOps): Sales confirms net-new. Requesting sales credit. I’ll run margin impact but need to know if we can do an accelerated payment schedule or require an advance.
Elaine - Legal: I briefly reviewed the residency addendum. We’ll need language limiting scope + a 30-day cure for breaches. Also need to avoid custom warranty terms. I can draft redlines but need commercial approval first.
FinanceBot: ALERT: discount >20% requires CFO approval per pricing policy (doc: https://redwood.app/policies/pricing).
Alex P: Ok blocked by policy. @Priya (CFO) can you weigh in? If we approve, need an exec approval ticket and updated CLM entry.
Priya (CFO): Quick read — 25% on $240k ARR reduces gross margin below target but if this truly converts to Dedicated in 2026 and the account gives us references, I’m open to exception with conditions: (1) 50% upfront payment, (2) 6-month renewal at no discount, (3) Legal-approved residency clause.
Jamal R: Sales will push for 50% upfront. I’ll ask them to confirm and get the LOI updated.
Maria G: Once LOI updated, I’ll log the exception request in the deal desk tracker and route to Priya for sign-off. Elaine — can you prepare the redline by EOD?
Elaine - Legal: Yes, will prepare and attach to the tracker.
Sarah (RevOps): I’ll pre-calc margin with and without the renewal constraint and post it in the thread.
Priya (CFO): Conditional approval granted pending LOI + 50% upfront + Legal redline + deal desk entry. Add a one-time approval tag.
Jamal R: Great — I’ll update the customer and loop Sales ops. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
